sources.observation: Student bank describes official questions, student sign-in and assessment/domain/skill/difficulty filters.
Public stem guide distinguishes reading, synthesis, transition and grammar task patterns.
Official digital full-length practice is offered in Bluebook; paper forms are separately identified as nonadaptive.
Public bank page advertises filtering, explanations and progress; its displayed section counts differ from its headline total.
Public pacing description lists section/skill/difficulty/count/pace controls and speed/accuracy stars.
Public home page promotes diagnostics, tailored planning, tutoring and broader exam/college tools; authenticated execution was not tested.

capabilities.title: Student practice and filters

college-board.observation: Official student account and targeted question filters.

oneprep.observation: Advertised in-app filters, explanations and solved/accuracy tracking.

aptmark.observation: Practice filters, server grading, bookmarks and history work locally.

capabilities.nextAcceptance: Keep identity/key checks and improve discovery; verify behavior rather than equating library counts.

capabilities.title: English task structure

college-board.observation: Official task/stem categories are the alignment reference.

oneprep.observation: Public skill-organized Reading and Writing bank.

aptmark.observation: All 11 skills have original candidates and private method metadata.

capabilities.nextAcceptance: Add varied original passages and independent editorial review; distinguish family reuse from independently written contexts.

capabilities.title: Content provenance and validity

college-board.observation: Official questions come from the assessment developer.

oneprep.observation: Publicly describes its content as human-written; editorial process was not independently audited.

aptmark.observation: Candidate content remains subject to explicit human-review, publication and calibration gates.

capabilities.nextAcceptance: Obtain named human review and empirical evidence; automated validation and inventory size do not establish equivalence.

capabilities.title: Timed study

college-board.observation: Official full-length digital practice uses Bluebook, not Aptmark timers.

oneprep.observation: Advertises configurable speed/accuracy drills with stars.

aptmark.observation: Bounded English/Math pacing sets preserve deadlines and lock explanations.

capabilities.nextAcceptance: Keep personal pacing separate from validated forms and avoid unsupported improvement or speed-reward claims.

capabilities.title: Full-length forms and scores

college-board.observation: Official digital forms and separate nonadaptive paper forms are available.

oneprep.observation: Advertises practice tests and projected scores; validity has not been independently evaluated here.

aptmark.observation: Only diagnostic and Math engineering previews; no validated full-length form or predicted SAT score.

capabilities.nextAcceptance: Require approved forms, route-pool assembly, independent review and psychometric support before score/form claims.

capabilities.title: Planning and actual-record progress

college-board.observation: Student bank supports targeted self-directed practice; this source does not establish live calendar synchronization.

oneprep.observation: Promotes plans that respond to test date and practice accuracy.

aptmark.observation: Actual-record planning/analytics and portable calendar export are implemented.

capabilities.nextAcceptance: Evaluate recommendation usefulness with real outcomes and distinguish calendar export from provider synchronization.

capabilities.title: Explanations and tutoring

college-board.observation: Skill/stem guidance explains the official task categories.

oneprep.observation: Promotes instant follow-up tutoring and walkthroughs.

aptmark.observation: Worked explanations and a grounded static guide; no connected generative tutor.

capabilities.nextAcceptance: Evaluate grounded provider behavior and operating budgets before advertising connected AI tutoring.

capabilities.title: Broader courses and hosted service

college-board.observation: Reference is SAT Suite practice; unrelated admissions tooling is not inferred.

oneprep.observation: Promotes ACT/AP and college-application services in addition to SAT study.

aptmark.observation: Local-first SAT preview; broader courses and hosted cross-device accounts remain open.

capabilities.nextAcceptance: Prioritize SAT foundations and original content; broader-course parity and hosted operations require separate acceptance.

countCaveat: OnePrep page headline says 4000+, while displayed section figures 1492 and 2390 sum to 3882. These are reported public figures, not an independently audited inventory or a quality ranking.
